objective: Locate the first 1ms discrepancy before numerical promotion; distinguish event timing from interface delivery and operator/initial-state mismatch. User authorizes proceeding to stage3 only when evidence and external review support readiness.

hypotheses.A: Identical event counts with different sampled peak times alter analytical synaptic filters; endpoint membrane tolerances alone miss this error.
hypotheses.B: Waveform initial values, accepted-versus-predictor history or publication order differs; replaying identical events would still produce a discrepancy.
hypotheses.C: Starting effective operator, external inputs or physical state differs; the discrepancy precedes the first differing event.

first_pair: Reference_cuda and causal_cuda, same unmodified1ms sham history; record boundaries, event marks, full CNS state and membrane inputs. Instrumentation must preserve prior exported endpoints exactly.
prospective_followups: If A is isolated, use fixed predeclared cell step ceilings6250ns and1562ns as convergence diagnostics on replayed identical inputs, not select-until-PASS. If B or C, minimal implementation repair plus affected paired rerun within remaining loads. At most two numerical candidates; no physiological retuning.

criteria.causality: Reconstruct q/s from recorded incoming state, exact event marks and declared time constants. Compare residual separately from differences in input histories.
criteria.performance: Measure actual organism with observation/load/serialization separated; never promote from synthetic or membrane-only speed.

stop: A located and reproduced cause, repaired implementation with bounded verification, or exhausted budget. No automatic stage3 admission from agreement of reviewers alone. Preserve failures; subsequent architectural rounds require a distinct justified hypothesis and a new finite plan.
